title: Doll
summary: 12 designs, 30 copies in the lottery box; placed inside or on top.

sections.note: Size is in bag-grid cells (width × height). "In box" is how many copies the lottery box holds. The share assumes every copy is equally likely; the box list also gives each design a weight (rarer merch has a higher one) whose role is unclear.
